kind: hardware candidate evidence (one machine; not the owner acceptance, not field data)
limitations: Software-rendered numbers are never reported as hardware: a software renderer ends the run with every row OPEN.
The render CPU time is a CPU-only estimate of draw submission; GPU time comes from timer queries when the extension exists.
Idle, traversal, Pause, hidden and Footer windows are measured on this machine only; phones need their own runs.
The 200% and 400% checks are viewport-equivalent, not browser-UI zoom. The accessibility tree is a proxy, not a screen reader.
renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (0x00001F08) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

idle.fpsMethod: intervals over the span of the frame timestamps

pageOnlyControl.note: requestAnimationFrame intervals while the page scrolls with the scene paused (no scene draws): the cost of the page itself

paused.note: timeout calls come from the whole page and are reported, not gated

hidden.draws: not measured (the page was not hidden: run with --headed so the window can be minimized)

cache.note: transfer sizes are uncompressed, as the local server sends them; the Brotli size of the closure is gated by measure:connected-studio. Cache reuse is reported apart and never subtracts from the cold figure.

contrast.method: each text element is hidden, the viewport is screenshotted, and the WCAG contrast between the computed text colour (alpha blended) and the pixels behind its box is recorded: the gate is the 5th percentile over the box (the single worst pixel is reported too), and text covered by another element is skipped; large text is 24 px, or 18.66 px bold, and needs 3:1, everything else 4.5:1
